name_zh: 克拉玛依市世界魔鬼城景区
address_zh: 新疆维吾尔自治区克拉玛依市乌尔禾区龙脊路200号
address_en: No. 200, Longji Road, Urho District, Karamay City, Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region
intro_zh: 克拉玛依市世界魔鬼城，又称乌尔禾风城，是在干旱、大风环境下形成的一种风蚀地貌类型。魔鬼城呈西北、东西走向，长宽约在5公里以上，方圆约10平方公里，地面海拔350米左右，城内形成了形态各异的风蚀岩群，其形状或如殿、台、阁、堡，或如人、禽、兽，蔚然壮观，神秘莫测，成为世界奇景之一。
intro_en: The World Devil City in Karamay City, also known as Urho Wind City, is a type of wind-eroded landform formed in a drought and windy environment. The Devil's City runs northwest and east-west, with a length and width of more than 5 kilometers, a radius of about 10 square kilometers, and a ground altitude of about 350 meters. A group of wind-eroded rocks of various shapes have been formed in the city. Their shapes may be like palaces, platforms, pavilions, castles, or people, birds, or beasts. They are spectacular, mysterious and unpredictable, and have become one of the wonders of the world.

foreign_visitors.note_en: Most 5A sites admit international visitors; passport-based reservations may be required. Check the official site before travelling.
